title: 2匹のカエル (Ni-hiki no Kaeru / Two Frogs)
description: Two frogs — one living in a pond near Osaka, one near Kyoto — decide to travel to see each other's city. They meet in the middle on a hilltop, stand on their hind legs to look ahead, and each sees only the city they came from (not knowing their eyes point backward when standing up). Both go home convinced the other city looks exactly like their own. A delightfully short and funny folk tale that teaches beginner readers about perspective and assumptions.
author: Traditional Japanese Folk Tale
